name: Furiman NIE Hen
source:
During predecessor rule a riot occurred, and most of the disciples went elsewhere. Main character is the most experienced person among the remaining ones. He takes control and continues study and practices with new vigor.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
前任时期发生骚乱，弟子大多流散。主角是剩下的人中最有经验的人。他掌控了一切，并以新的活力继续学习和实践。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
